title: ADK CM-03 tester with scoped tools, guardrail callbacks and an execution log
area: Google ADK and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform
scenario: ControlPilot's CM-03 tester moves onto Google ADK. The shared tool registry contains a write tool from another skill, and the change system holds out-of-sample and confidential tickets. Build the agent so it can read only the sample, never write outside record_result, stays within a tool budget, logs every call, and has its final answer checked against session state. A scripted BaseLlm plays the model.
task: Write a before_tool_callback: allow-list, sample scoping for change ids and PRs, result values, a budget in session state
Write an after_tool_callback that logs one entry per call with blocked flags and result digests
Wire the ADK Agent with only the allowed tools and run it with Runner and a session
Validate the final summary strictly and cross-check it against what record_result stored
acceptance: Out-of-sample and unlinked calls are blocked and never executed
close_change is never offered and never runs
One log entry per call, in order, including blocked calls
Summary mismatches, gaps and free text end in needs_review

practices.label: Week 3 Mon - ADK agents, tools and Runner
Week 3 Wed - callbacks as guardrails, custom models for offline tests
